name: io.github.theYahia/tochka-bank-mcp
title: Tochka Bank
description: Tochka Bank business API (Russia) - accounts, balances, statements, payments for signing

environmentVariables.name: TOCHKA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client id from the Tochka developer cabinet

environmentVariables.name: TOCHKA_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pre-issued refresh token for headless setups (skips the `auth` step)

environmentVariables.name: TOCHKA_MAX_PAYMENT_RUB
environmentVariables.description: Max amount allowed in create_payment, RUB (default 100000)

environmentVariables.name: TOCHKA_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of recipient accounts for create_payment

environmentVariables.name: TOCHKA_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for an async statement to become ready, ms (default 25000)
